ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels, approximately 1:7, with white predominantly confined to the distal tips and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-contrast white mottling at the leftmost distal tip; high-frequency white pixel clusters along the leading edge of both lobes; distinctive vertical white parallel banding on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular serrations with sharp-angled peaks (approx. 20-30 pixels). Right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-frequency, more rounded undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a clear concave curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges follow a convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 5-7 parallel vertical white linear disruptions located on the upper surface of the right lobe; sparse, non-aligned diagonal white scratches visible on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged, non-uniform indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating potential prior physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel erosion and dense white speckling concentrated on the extreme point of the left lobe tip.
